headline: US Annual Labor Productivity Growth Reaches 1.9%, Fitch Reports
summary: Credit rating agency Fitch Ratings reported that annual US labor productivity growth has risen to 1.9%, adding that it remains too early to isolate AI as the primary driver.
why: Labor productivity growth dictates non-inflationary wage expansion potential and influences long-term central bank interest rate trajectories.

impacts.name: United States
impacts.why: Productivity gains support economic growth while mitigating wage-driven inflationary pressures.
